items.html: And therefore when we say the word "Israel," in order to bring him the addition of illumination as mentioned, behold, we draw him another level above the aforementioned, and it is the inner Mochin of the Katnut of Aba. And it is found that when he raises Mayin Nukvin in the word "Echad" to Aba and Ima, behold, he is already complete and filled more; and therefore he draws from the externality of Arich Anpin, which is a more excellent level. For afterwards, in the word "Echad," the encircling Mochin of the Katnut of Aba enter into him, and the inner VAK of the Gadlut of Ima. And since he did not now receive new added illuminations, therefore he has the power to receive in the evening prayer other, higher Mochin, and they are the inner VAK of the Gadlut of Aba, as will be said in its place, with the help of God. And therefore also that coupling is Jacob and Leah, while they are above the chest.
